recentItems.title: The Legend of Khiimori - Official ‘The Mongolian Expanse’ Launch Trailer
recentItems.description:
Don't miss ‘The Mongolian Expanse’ Launch Trailer for The Legend of Khiimori, an open-world adventure exploration game developed by Aesir Interactive and Nightin Games. Players will navigate Mongolia's expanding wilderness in a whole new region to the Snowy Mountains. Take on new challenges and discover what awaits in ‘The Mongolian Expanse’ for The Legend of Khiimori, available now on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

recentItems.title: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Official Version 1.0 Launch Trailer
recentItems.description:
The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of the Bronze Age leaves early access, and version 1.0 is out now on Steam for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Watch The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of the Bronze Age version 1.0 launch trailer for the stroy-driven, base-building RTS game, which brings Story Act 4 and a new Map Editor.

As drought, famine, and war unravel the Bronze Age world, players lead a small caravan through a character-driven campaign where every settlement must sustain the people defending it. Food powers population, armies, and progress: recruiting more soldiers can secure your borders while straining the fields that keep everyone alive.

recentItems.title: Muay Thai Xtreme - Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer
recentItems.description:
Take a look at the Gameplay Reveal Trailer for Muay Thai Xtreme, an action 3D fighting game developed by SquadX. Players can get an in-depth look at the core gameplay, bringing the authentic Thai fighting style to the masses. Get the rundown on strikes, blocks, tournaments, and more in Muay Thai Xtreme, coming soon to PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Anno 117: Pax Romana - Official Dawn of The Delta Launch Trailer
recentItems.description:
Don't miss the launch trailer for Anno 117: Pax Romana Dawn of The Delta DLC for the fan favourite city-building strategy series. Dawn of The Delta takes you to the blistering sun and sand of Egypt, as you balance the Roman ways with the traditional Egyptian religion and culture. Leaning one way or the other too much will cause consequences, that rivals will jump on! 
Play Anno 117 Pax Romana Dawn of The Delta now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC (Steam, Ubisoft Connect) and Xbox Series X|S.

recentItems.title: Knuckle Creek - Official Launch Trailer
recentItems.description:
Learn about Knuckle Creek via the power of song in this stop-motion launch trailer for arena brawling party game. Knuckle Creek is available now on Steam.

Using a combination of clay animation, scanned clay models and 3d modelling, developer Claymatic Games brings their distinctive clay look to an arcade game that lets you smack your way through a series of solo stages, or join up with up to 8 friends in couch play or online battles as you compete to become conqueror of the countryside!

#IGN #gaming

recentItems.title: Vibe Together - Official Announcement Trailer
recentItems.description:
Here's your look at the announcement trailer for Vibe Together, an upcoming multiplayer music-making game. It is a hybrid game and music software that is built around exploration and discovery. Vibe Together will be available on Steam in 2027. A demo is coming soon.

Build songs in a new way by connecting objects together! A visual music sandbox for you to create solo or with friends. No music experience needed. Share what you make with the community and turn each song into a level you can play in different experiences like a rhythm game or a bullet heaven. 

Instead of arranging clips on a timeline, players build together in a shared space of placed nodes and connections. Music is visualized: rhythm is defined by the distance between objects, and pitch is shown by color. Signals travel along the connections, triggering beats and melodies as they reach each node. Players can see how their song works and reshape it while it plays, alone or with up to seven other people.

recentItems.description:
The Sift is in danger! Something ancient is stirring beneath the ground of the new dimension – a threat that has slumbered for ages and is now beginning to wake. Gather your trusty allies, venture deep into unexplored reaches, take on the not-so-happy humblers, and confront the foes behind their rude awakening! The Humblers Awaken is coming December 1.

recentItems.title: Ironholm: Reign of the Isles - Official Early Access Trailer
recentItems.description:
Check out the Early Access Launch trailer for Ironholm: Reign of the Isles, a medieval real-time strategy game developed by Data Innovation Lab. Expand your kingdom, raise armies, and capture new regions while commanding entire forces instead of individual soldiers. Plan your expansion, reinforce key positions, and choose the right moment to strike. Ironholm: Reign of the Isles is available now in Early Access on PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Once Human - Official Season 5: Dissonant Resonance Gameplay Trailer
recentItems.description:
Check out gameplay from Season 5: Dissonant Resonance of Once Human in this latest trailer for the survival game set in a strange, post-apocalyptic future. Unite with friends to fight monstrous enemies, uncover secret plots, compete for resources, and build your own territory. Once, you were merely human. Now, you have the power to remake the world. Once Human is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, PC, and mobile. Season 5: Dissonant Resonance begins in Once Human on November 18, 2026 (PT).
